summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer 2024.1 New Feature - [Beta] AI Texture Generator ## Introduction In this video, we will learn how to use the AI sticker generator. This tool allows you to create stickers based on your chosen keywords, and you can check the effect in the 3D window. ## Preparing to Use the AI Sticker Generator Before running the AI sticker generator, please add a sticker to the costume first. By adjusting the sticker tool, select the sticker that needs to be replaced with the picture. ## Accessing the AI Sticker Generator In the sticker attribute, click the AI sticker generator button on the default side. The AI sticker generator window will pop up. ### Setting Up the Generator In the options at the top of the dialogue window, you can set the type of picture and whether to open a transparent background. Then, enter your keyword. Below the keyword input, the final picture generated will be displayed. ### Viewing History Records In the history record window, you can see the history of the pictures generated, including the previous images. At the top of each picture in the history record, you can view the selected options and keywords used to generate that particular image. The history record will remain until you close Marvelous Designer. ## Exploring AI Sticker Generator Options Next, let's take a look at the various options of the AI sticker generator. You can select the style category of the pattern in the pattern category. Under the art style, you can choose a specific sticker art style. If you do not need to specify any special art style, you can select "none." ### Background Options If you choose a transparent background, please note that the background of the sticker generated will be transparent. However, you cannot generate a transparent background art sticker. ## Generating Stickers Now let's enter the keyword and start generating the sticker. When you enter the keyword, using English keywords will help you generate more accurate pictures. After entering the keyword, click the generate button to create a picture. ### Randomness in Generation The generated pictures are continuous in all directions. The AI sticker generator produces images randomly each time. Therefore, even if the keywords are the same, the generation results will be diverse. ## Tips for Effective Keyword Use When entering keywords, we recommend using individual words rather than long sentences. Long sentences may lead to incorrect results. It is advisable to define keywords with concise terms. If you want to emphasize a keyword, please emphasize it with the keyword itself. ### Keyword Weighting The keywords you use will give more weight to the generation process. When you use a keyword once, its weight will be 1.1 times. When you use a keyword twice, its weight will increase to 1.2 times. You will notice that different keywords yield different results. ## Random Generation If you want to generate a picture randomly, click the random icon in the input form. The random icon will set and generate keywords at random. By doing this, you can create various types of pictures, enriching your creative process. ## Keeping and Modifying Keywords When you want to generate a new picture similar to a previous result or wish to update some keywords, please click the Keep Keywords button. By clicking Create, you will see that the generated picture is similar to the previous one. ### Modifying Keywords Please note that if you modify keywords, the results may differ due to the addition or modification of those keywords. You may need to generate a picture multiple times to achieve the desired image. ## Managing the Generation Window To manage the generation window, click the arrow button in the upper right corner to fold it. While waiting for the picture to be created, you can continue to adjust the costume or make other changes. When the picture is created, the foldable window will notify you. ## Applying Your Creation If you need to open the window, click the arrow in the upper right corner again. Once the picture is created, click the application button at the bottom. You can also go to the history record and use previous pictures as stickers. This function allows you to add more interesting content to your design. ## Conclusion Thank you for watching! See you in the next video. ```
